section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of body pride using the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES-AP), a 6-item measure rated on a 5-point scale. The text reports internal consistency estimates (Cronbach's α = .95 for women and .97 for men) but does not provide study-level demographic data, sample characteristics, or correlation analyses.
